name: axis-in-domain
description: A tension as one of a domain's three axes: which line it is and which of its poles is yang there. Refines the tension; the domain is given by in-domain, the yang pole by yang-pole.

aiGuidance.purpose: Polarity is judged in relation: within one domain, on one axis. This record holds that judgement. It refines exactly one tension, is in-domain exactly one domain record, and names exactly one yang-pole, one of the two poles its tension contains. A domain has at most three affirmed axes, on distinct lines. A narrower domain may hold its own axis for the same tension with the other pole as yang.
aiGuidance.extraction: Title as '<tension> in <domain>'. Line 1-3. A one-sentence summary of why this tension is an axis here.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not name the domain, the tension or the yang pole in a text field; link them. Do not infer polarity from relation order or from an archetype's name.
